summary: BORTEN INVEST AS (org. no. 922 164 584) is a private limited company (AS) based in Kongsvinger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2019-02-04. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 26 565. CEO: Didrik Knapperholen Borten; board chair: Didrik Knapperholen Borten.
